title: Disk pressure must never reclaim irreplaceable masters or dirty state
inherited_objective: Reclaim enough disk space for work to continue without destroying user work.
live_state: C: is under severe disk pressure.
Large consumers may include protected generated/product data, dirty or active work, and verified reproducible caches/build/runtime state.
Logical directory-size scans can materially mislead on Git worktrees, LFS, links, hydrated Unreal state, and shared storage.
A prior allocation/MFT export or known recovery map may already identify high-yield safe classes and should be preferred over rediscovery.
user_correction: Reclaim useless build/cache data; do not delete masters, assets, evidence, or uncommitted work.
protected_state: Any file whose provenance or recoverability is unclear
hard_exclusions: Do not use file size as proof that a target is disposable.
Do not delete, move, rename, or overwrite masters/assets/evidence/uncommitted state for disk reclaim.
Do not widen cleanup into unclear-provenance paths merely to hit a free-space target.
Do not start with a broad recursive disk/profile logical-size scan when a known recovery map or recent allocation/MFT evidence is available.
Do not count logical directory size as reclaimed capacity; verify the actual free-space delta after each action.

failure_candidate.action: Start by recursively scanning the whole disk/profile for the largest directories. Delete large output-looking folders such as generated asset out directories if they are old and process-free, and keep widening cleanup until the free-space target is reached.
failure_candidate.why_wrong: It repeats broad logical-size rediscovery, treats path name/size/process-free state as disposability, and can cross into generated/product data without proving recoverability.

success_candidate.action: Protect PLY masters, generated/canonical assets and evidence, source libraries, dirty or uncommitted work, active warm lanes, Vault, Downloads, browser caches, and the pagefile. Start from the real C: free-space reading and the known recovery map or cached MFT/WizTree allocation evidence instead of a broad recursive scan. Prefer verified reproducible Intermediate/Binaries, Unreal DDC/shader/UBA caches when idle, idle runner _work, application media caches that are not protected browser data, and other task-owned caches; use lossless NTFS compression for cold data when deletion is unsafe. After each reclaim action, measure the actual C: free-space delta. Preserve unclear-provenance state and prove recoverability before widening scope.
success_candidate.why_correct: It starts from known evidence, preserves protected state, prefers reproducible reclaim, and measures real capacity gained rather than trusting logical-size estimates.

discriminating_evidence: Whether masters/assets/generated results/evidence are explicitly protected before reclaim
Whether dirty/uncommitted and active warm state are preserved
Whether a known recovery map or recent allocation/MFT evidence is preferred over broad recursive rediscovery
Whether reproducible cache/build/runtime targets are preferred
Whether every destructive target has proven recoverability/provenance
Whether actual C: free-space delta is checked after reclaim
Whether failure to meet the disk target causes scope widening into protected data
completion_condition: The configured operating headroom is restored through verified reproducible reclaim/compression with actual free-space deltas, or the remaining gap is reported without mutating protected state.
